nar.text: The circuit was wet as the Grand Prix cars lined up in 3-2-3 formation.
However, shortly before the start Varzi insisted to take part even when the team doubted he would be able to do the whole race.

Taruffi moved first on the wet track and tried to find a gap between Caracciola and Varzi and five cars went over the line side by side until Taruffi fell back while von Brauchitsch's Mercedes went into the lead followed by Caracciola, Varzi, Stuck and Fagioli.
Chiron had missed the start completely while Dreyfus crossed the grid from right to left to follow Taruffi.
He pulled away from the others and at the end of the first lap he was leading by 22 seconds over Caracciola.
Varzi and Stuck follow closely in third and fourth; Rosemeyer is ninth. Froy makes a lengthy stop for plugs.
Von Brauchitsch led by 35 seconds after the second lap having completed the lap in 11m23s. Varzi stopped for a plugs change.
Froy retires with ignition trouble; Rosemeyer is up to seventh.
Von Brauchitsch extends his lead to 54 seconds. Stuck pits for plugs and Fagioli moves up to make it a Mercedes 1-2-3.
One of those suffering was Stuck, who stopped in the pit at the end of the lap to change plugs. Fagioli took over third position making it a Mercedes-Benz 1-2-3.
Von Brauchitsch was even faster on the fourth lap with a time of 11m08.1s increasing his lead to over one minute. Neubauer hang out a signal ordering him to moderate his speed.
Varzi stops again for plugs; Chiron is fourth, Rosemeyer fifth. Stuck pits again and Zehender retires with plug problems.
Rosemeyer had had his windshield smashed by a stone.
Stuck's third plug stop doesn't cure the misfire. Rosemeyer, ordered to push, passes Chiron after a brief duel.
At the end of the lap Fagioli stopped for plugs and refueled at the same time.
Rosemeyer laps in 11m05s, 10 seconds quicker than the leading Mercedes; Varzi hands his car to Prince zu Leiningen.
Varzi finally gave up and handed his Auto Union over to reserve driver Prince zu Leiningen, who was ordered to go flat out in an attempt to at least keep to the position.
Now it was von Brauchitsch's turn to suffer from plug trouble and in the bad conditions his lap time increased by over two minutes to 13m23s.
In heavy rain Rosemeyer laps in 12m08s, 46 seconds faster than Caracciola, and catches him at the line.
the Auto Union pulled up beside the Mercedes as they passed the finish line and going in to the Südkehle Rosemeyer took over second position.
When he tried to lap Balestrero the engine could not stand the pressure anymore and the supercharger blew.
Rosemeyer leads; he laps in 11m55s and is four seconds clear of Caracciola, with Chiron third. Taruffi crashes his Bugatti.
Rosemeyer, racing flat out with the wheels often going over the edge of the course, held a seven seconds lead over Caracciola.
Caracciola follows the Auto Union closely; Rosemeyer, down two cylinders with ignition trouble, carries on.
Lang spins at Planzgarten into the ditch, is pushed back onto the course and rejoins fifth.
Going into Schwalbenschwanz Caracciola made an attempt to pass but was blocked by the Rosemeyer.

Coming out of Schwalbenschwanz Rosemeyer changed gear too early and Caracciola was able to keep up with the Auto Union on the long straight and he passed at the breaking point for Hohenrain to take the flag 1.9 seconds in front of the Auto Union.
Chiron finishes third, Fagioli fourth, Lang and Pietsch fifth and sixth, then Dreyfus, Etancelin and zu Leiningen in Varzi's car.
